name: Vincent Valare
source:
The most thoughtful person I know. If you didn't know him, he might appear shy, because of how quiet he usually is. Really, he's just always deep in thought. It can be intimidating sometimes, because he holds eye contact for a long time.

It's hard to figure out what he is thinking about and sometimes he will say something seemingly out of nowhere.

He is very kind to those who are kind to him, but remembers those who treat him poorly. He's really good at whatever he puts his time into. 

[From Idril's Phone Contacts In-Game]
